name: James Neuschburn
original_name: ジェームズ・ノイシュバーン
source:
[i]"And does your soul know of the true history?"[/i]

[i]A Crown of Pebbles[/i]

The current king of Hystorica.

He ascended to the throne after a struggle for power against his own siblings.

He has the dignified presence befitting a scion of the Goddess, but in reality he's a coward.

He also harbors a significant secret.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/fd/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
